messages:
maya: hey folks — I'm blocked cloning redwood/runtime after accepting the org invite. GitHub keeps telling me my email isn't verified for SSO and `ssh -T git@github.com` returns permission denied. Can someone point me to the fastest path to get repo access?

sam: hey maya, welcome! quick checklist: 1) did you accept the invite with the same GitHub account that you intended to use? 2) is your work email added & verified on that GH account? 3) do you have 2FA enabled (org requires it). Can you paste the exact error from SSH?

maya: here's the ssh test output i see: ```$ ssh -T git@github.comPermission denied (publickey).``` also when i try to open the repo in browser it shows a banner: "You must verify your email address to access this organization" and a button to "Authorize SAML" but clicking that goes to my personal account settings and shows my work email isn't listed.

ida (it): sounds like you accepted with a personal account that doesn't have your work email verified. Easiest fixes (pick one):
- add your company email to the GitHub account that accepted the invite, verify it, then re-authorize SSO
- OR accept the invite with your company GitHub account (if you have one) and make sure it's part of the org
Also enable 2FA (TOTP or security key) — org blocks access without it. I can re-send an invite to the work email if that helps.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: please complete 2FA and SSO authorization to unlock org repos. See onboarding checklist: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/gh-access

maya: I didn't realize, I had only my personal email on GH. I added my work email (maya@redwood.ai) and clicked the verification link. Enabling 2FA now. Attempting SSH test again...

maya: new ssh output: ```$ ssh -T git@github.comHi maya! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.```

sam: nice — SSH auth works now. @ida (it): can you add maya to eng-runtime team and grant write access to redwood/runtime? Maya, once you're on the team you should be able to clone & push.

ida (it): done — added Maya L to team "eng-runtime" and granted repo write to `redwood/runtime`. Also approved SSO for the account. You should have email confirming membership. :tada:

maya: cloned and pulled fine, thanks y'all! one quick Q: is SSH the preferred method for day-to-day dev here or should I use HTTPS + PAT?

sam: SSH is preferred for dev machines (faster, no token refresh). HTTPS + PAT is fine for CI or if you can't use SSH. If you want, add your laptop's SSH key to your GH account and to your gpg/ssh-agent config.

maya: will do. thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help :heart:

ida (it): if you hit any permission weirdness again ping #new-hires or @ida. Closing this thread once you confirm push works.

maya: pushed a small README tweak successfully — all good here :thumbsup:
